title: AI Trading OS
author: on_line187
selftext:
I started out making this for me and a few friends. I have been trading since 2014 but they are starting up so at first I gave them some learning material. Then some AI assistance and now it’s spun into a full AI Trading OS

There is a windows downloadable version that can connect to MT5 directly and test strategies/analyze your portfolio/give you signals. It can also do live trading for you based on your strategies/the signals it generates/or some other parameters. 

I have been testing it and will be documenting the tests live in the next weeks to show how it’s been doing for me. It does better than I do for sure. Over the past 4 months it has made 47% using my strategy but not my discipline. That has always been my biggest issue. 

It also builds a profile just for you that it learns over time. 

You can connect it to any LLM including a locally hosted model for complete privacy. 

The research tab checks over 150 different sources online  for data for forex/stocks/commodities/indexesand and crypto. I am running a BTC & ETH node already so I will implement crypto live analysis from that data also on whale movements and money tracking. That will be the next update in a few weeks hopefully. 

You can check it out here

https://aitradingos.com

There is a free version that essentially gives you all the data and none of the AI stuff so it doesn’t cost me so I am not charging for that. 

You can also run it completely locally though it is not open sourced … yet… may be… 🤷
